constraintsVi: Tôi muốn nghe hai bạn cùng lớp trao đổi về việc nghe podcast khi đi xe buýt; không cần thống nhất ý kiến.

profile.informationDensity: A few linked details and contrasting views.

segments.textEn: I often listen to podcasts on the bus. Short stories make the journey more interesting, and I usually remember what happened even if I miss a few words.
I find that difficult because the traffic noise distracts me. At home, I can concentrate on the speakers instead of trying to hear them over the engine.
That makes sense. I choose episodes about familiar topics, so I can follow the story without catching every detail. I leave interviews with lots of unfamiliar names for another time.
For me, the details are part of the fun. If I miss why someone made a decision, the rest of the story becomes less interesting, even when I understand the ending.
Perhaps we listen for different reasons. On the bus, I mostly want something enjoyable, rather than a lesson I need to remember. I can always listen again at home if a story interests me.
That explains it. I prefer giving a podcast my full attention. Your approach suits your journey, but I still enjoy mine more in a quiet room.
